intro: Spindrift Lemon from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) offers a refreshing, minimalist beverage option made with real ingredients. At just 3 calories per serving, this sparkling water combines carbonation with authentic lemon juice for a clean, citrusy taste. It is a perfect complement to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/), providing hydration without added sugars or artificial sweeteners.
priceCalories: Spindrift Lemon is priced between $2.95 and $3.25 at CAVA locations, making it an affordable beverage choice. With only 3 calories, 0g protein, 1g carbs, and 0g fat, this drink fits seamlessly into calorie-conscious meal plans. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal nutrition when adding this refreshing sparkling water to your order.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Spindrift Lemon apart is its ingredient simplicity and authenticity. Unlike artificially flavored seltzers, this beverage contains only sparkling water and real squeezed lemon juice. The brand commitment to real fruit creates a subtle, genuine citrus flavor that tastes like actual lemons. This transparency makes it a standout choice among CAVA drink options for health-conscious guests.
nutritionFacts: Spindrift Lemon delivers exceptional nutritional value with just 3 calories per serving and 1 gram of carbohydrates. The drink contains zero protein and zero fat, making it virtually calorie-free hydration. With no added sugars, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives, it aligns perfectly with clean eating goals. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for complete dietary information across all menu items.
whatsInside: This beverage contains only two simple ingredients: sparkling water and real lemon juice. The carbonated water provides effervescence and refreshment, while the squeezed lemon juice adds natural citrus flavor and a hint of tartness. There are no artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, or preservatives. This minimal ingredient list makes it suitable for various dietary preferences and restrictions.
tasteLike: Spindrift Lemon tastes like crisp sparkling water with a subtle, authentic lemon essence. The flavor is light and refreshing rather than overly sweet or artificial. You will notice real citrus notes with gentle tartness that cleanses your palate. The carbonation adds a pleasant fizz that enhances the drinking experience without overwhelming the delicate lemon flavor throughout each sip.
customize: Spindrift Lemon comes ready-to-drink and requires no customization, making it a convenient beverage choice. Simply order it alongside your [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) selection. For added flavor, you could request a lemon wedge on the side. The drink pairs well with any CAVA meal combination without modification needed.
pairsWell: This sparkling lemon water pairs excellently with Mediterranean flavors throughout CAVA menu offerings. It complements protein-rich options from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and balances bold flavors from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). The citrus notes enhance grilled chicken, falafel, or spicy harissa dishes. It also refreshes your palate between bites of rich hummus or creamy tzatziki.
healthyChoice: Spindrift Lemon is an excellent healthy beverage choice with only 3 calories and no added sugars. The real lemon juice provides natural vitamin C and antioxidants without artificial additives. It keeps you hydrated while supporting weight management and clean eating goals. This drink works perfectly for keto, paleo, vegan, and low-carb diets, making it universally diet-friendly.
howToOrder: Order Spindrift Lemon at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it when selecting your beverage. It is available at the drink station or can be added during checkout when ordering online. Simply specify Spindrift Lemon as your drink choice alongside your bowl, pita, or salad. The staff will provide the sealed bottle with your meal order.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade at 260-360 calories, Spindrift Lemon offers a dramatically lighter option at just 3 calories. While Blueberry Lavender lemonades contain 140-190 calories with added sweeteners, Spindrift uses only real lemon juice and sparkling water. For guests seeking authentic fruit flavor without sugar, Spindrift provides superior ingredient quality and nutritional benefits over sweetened alternatives.
whoShouldTry: Anyone seeking a refreshing, low-calorie beverage should try Spindrift Lemon at CAVA. It is ideal for health-conscious diners, those managing calorie intake, or guests avoiding artificial ingredients. People following keto, paleo, or diabetic-friendly diets will appreciate the minimal carbohydrates and zero sugar content. If you prefer subtle, natural flavors over sweet drinks, this sparkling water is perfect.
worthTrying: Spindrift Lemon is definitely worth trying for its exceptional quality and ingredient integrity. At $2.95-$3.25, you receive a premium sparkling beverage made with real fruit juice and nothing artificial. The refreshing taste, minimal calories, and clean ingredient list make it an outstanding value. It elevates your CAVA dining experience while supporting your health goals effortlessly.
